Package index

Differential expression

Volcano and MA plots over a differential-expression results table. Both wrap the VizModules scatter plot module, adding threshold controls and an auto-generated Up/Down/n.s. grouping.

Bulk expression

Sample-level views of a bulk RNA-seq (or array) experiment held in a SummarizedExperiment: the sample PCA (feeding the PCAtools biplot), the sample-distance heatmap, and the heatmap of the top differentially expressed genes. The two heatmaps wrap VizModules’ ComplexHeatmap module, so they are InteractiveComplexHeatmap widgets rather than plotly figures.

Somatic mutations

Cohort views of somatic mutations from a maftools MAF object or a data frame in MAF columns - the oncoplot, the MAF summary dashboard and the protein lollipop plot, built natively in plotly and checked against maftools - and the 96-channel substitution spectrum of a mutational count matrix.

Structural biology

AlphaFold prediction confidence (per-residue pLDDT and the predicted aligned error), an interactive 3D structure viewer for PDB / mmCIF files, and molecular dynamics trajectory metrics from GROMACS .xvg output. structureViewer is the one module here that is not a plotly figure: it is an NGL widget with its own PNG snapshot.

Single-cell and RNA-seq (dittoSeq)

Wrappers around the dittoSeq plotting functions. Each takes a SingleCellExperiment, Seurat or SummarizedExperiment object rather than a data frame, and so takes object_list in its *App(). dittoHeatmap wraps VizModules’ ComplexHeatmap module, so it is an InteractiveComplexHeatmap widget rather than a plotly figure.

Module Gallery & Figure Builder

Every module in one app, each on example data with its main features switched on, and the VizModules Figure Builder for arranging several of these modules into one multi-panel figure.

sciModuleGalleryApp()
Launch the sciVizModules module gallery
sci_figure_builder_registry()
Module registry for the VizModules Figure Builder
sciFigureBuilderApp()
Figure Builder app seeded with the sciVizModules modules

Example data

Bundled datasets used by the example apps, the vignette and the tests. This package sets no LazyData, so load them with data().

Example DESeq2 results from airway dataset
airway_edger
Example edgeR results from airway dataset
airway_voom
Example limma-voom results from airway dataset
dose_response
Example dose-response data (simulated)

Example diagnostic biomarker data (simulated)

Example copy number segmentation results from sesame
example_enrichment
Example functional enrichment results (simulated)
example_gsea

example_gwas
Example GWAS summary statistics (simulated)

Example PCAtools pca object (airway RNA-seq)
example_plate
Example assay plates
example_sbs96
Example single-base-substitution spectra (simulated)

survival_lung
